q: Which Meta campaigns are wasting money in the last 7 days? Rank them and tell me what to do about them.

answer:
Verdict: Over 2026-10-12..2026-10-18 Meta campaigns spent ₹2,35,838 and returned net sales ₹2,03,894 on the campaigns that recorded sales — overall ROAS ~1.05x, but 18.0% of spend (₹42,406) bought no orders. That 18% leakage and a few low-ROAS campaigns are where money is wasted now.

What is working
- TH-471-PLAYSCRATCHLOUNGE-13OCT-PMF — spend ₹18,602 → net sales ₹40,910 = 2.20x, 17 orders. Reliable top performer to scale cautiously.
- TH-287-MISTCALMBRUSH-16OCT — spend ₹7,584 → net sales ₹11,702 = 1.54x, 6 orders.
- TH-452-FLEXIDINEFEEDER-12OCT — spend ₹10,313 → net sales ₹13,591 = 1.32x, 8 orders.

Where money is leaking
- No-orders campaigns: 17 of 49 campaigns recorded zero orders and absorbed ₹42,406 (18.0% of Meta spend). Largest no-order spenders include DOG DAD T-SHIRT-CS-06OCT and TH-229-BLUEJAY SNEAKS-15OCT.
- Low-ROAS campaign (enough orders to judge): TH-012-SNUGBOO-23SEP — spend ₹11,870 → net sales ₹10,240 = 0.86x (shortfall ~₹1,630).
- Portfolio efficiency: 106 orders total, ad spend per order ₹2,225 — spend is concentrated but not all converting.

Why (what the data shows)
- A substantial share of spend is on campaigns that produced no recorded orders in the week (direct leakage). 
- One mid-sized campaign (TH-012) has measurable shortfall vs spend. 
- Several small campaigns show good ROAS but have too few orders to be reliable signals.

What I would do (prioritised, with the figures to validate each step)
1) Stop or zero-budget the 17 campaigns with no orders (saves ₹42,406 = 18.0% of spend) and reallocate that budget to proven performers (start with TH-471). Check: if any paused campaign records an order within 3 days, consider reinstating; otherwise keep paused.
2) Cut or cap spend on TH-012-SNUGBOO-23SEP (spend ₹11,870; ROAS 0.86). Put it on a short creative/landing check and limit daily spend until its 7-day ROAS reaches ≥1.0 (or orders rise). Check: if next 7 days still ROAS <1, pause.
3) Redirect freed budget to TH-471 (ROAS 2.20, 17 orders) and to TH-287/TH-452 while monitoring ad spend per order and ROAS. Stop reallocations if their ROAS falls toward portfolio average or ad spend per order exceeds current portfolio ₹2,225.

Notes
- Basis: net sales are order-date net sales; ad spend is platform native (Meta). Brand: default brand (Tilting Heads) scope applied. Period: 2026-10-12..2026-10-18. Data as of 2026-10-19.
- Sample size: campaigns labelled “early signal” had <5 orders — treat them as low-confidence for scaling decisions.
- The queries returned 49 campaigns with spend; 32 campaigns recorded net sales.

Period: 2026-10-12..2026-10-18 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-19
